d: Job Description - Early Years Foundation Stage - Arabic Teacher
Location: Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia

International Schools seeks a qualified Early Years Arabic teacher with expertise in running play-based classrooms in Arabic and developing young students' language and literacy. The successful candidate will also provide targeted Arabic phonics and early literacy intervention for individual students.
q: Qualifications: Relevant bachelor's degree and recognised Early Years teaching qualification
Teaching Experience: Proven experience teaching Arabic in Early Years, particularly language and literacy development
Language Proficiency: Excellent spoken and written Arabic, with intermediate English proficiency
Classroom Management: Ability to deliver engaging, play-based learning and maintain a positive classroom environment
Child Development: Strong understanding of early childhood development and age-appropriate teaching practices
Arabic Literacy: Expertise in Arabic phonics, vocabulary, early reading and writing
Individual Support: Ability to assess learning needs and provide targeted literacy interventions
Assessment & Inclusion: Experience supporting diverse learning abilities and language backgrounds
Professional Skills: Strong communication, collaboration, parent engagement and safeguarding awareness
Safeguarding: Understand safeguarding responsibilities, professional boundaries and confidentiality, and report concerns promptly through school procedures
Experience in an international or bilingual Early Years setting
Familiarity with Cambridge Early Years framework
Further training in early childhood education, Arabic phonics, literacy intervention or additional-language teaching
Experience developing Arabic learning resources and supporting transition into primary

Candidates should demonstrate their expertise through a play-based Arabic teaching activity, a short individual literacy intervention plan, and discussion of how they assess and respond to students' progress
Having a teaching license is required
Experience teaching early years and Arabic
